newsitem.title: USA: Mrs. Clinton's wardrobe announced for inauguration.
newsitem.headline: Mrs. Clinton's wardrobe announced for inauguration.

text.p: Hillary Rodham Clinton's wardrobe for inauguration events is being created by designer Oscar de la Renta, the White House announced on Tuesday.

The wardrobe includes "a long embroidered tulle gown with a matching satin cape" for the balls she and President Bill Clinton will attend on the night of his inauguration for a second term on Monday, according to a statement.
For the swearing-in ceremony itself, her wardrobe includes "a wool suit with matching melton coat."

The New York designer, a native of the Dominican Republic, has made clothes for Mrs. Clinton before, including the Democratic National Convention and election night in Little Rock as well as the Kennedy Centre Honours and the French State Dinner. She and de la Renta started discussing her wardrobe after Clinton was re-elected on Nov. 5, the White House said.
